chapter: Leaving Duke and the Hollywood years
title: Freelancing, Billy Berg's and touring with Freddie Slack
summary: After Duke he led his own groups, played Billy Berg's and studio work, and for two years traveled with Freddie Slack, making almost a movie a month, including some with Fred Astaire.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: So, whom did you play with next after you left Duke?
Oh, I've got groups of my own around here, and I worked at worked for Billy Berg Byrd and I worked the studios, freelanced there.
That was pretty lucrative, wasn't it?
Did you travel with Freddie Slack?
I know you recorded with him, right?
No. I traveled with him and made a lot of movies with him.
A lot of them were with Fred Astaire and a couple of them big gals. I can't think of their names offhand.

We was making a movie every month. Yeah, I was really good then. I made a movie practically every month and then the days we wasn't working we would go to San Diego and play a gig, go to anywhere. We used to go to San Jose to play a gig, San Francisco, everywhere.
